qr_encode — SYMBOL datacode2d op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.qr_encode(text, ec_level='M', version=None, mask=None, mode=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import qrsym; qrsym.qr_encode(text, ec_level='M', version=None, mask=None, mode=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opssymbol.get("qr_encode"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Encode a string into a QR Code (Model 2) module grid and its module-to-codeword map (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Encode text as a QR Code (Model 2) module grid.

Parameters

text : str

符号化する文字列 / the text. Byte mode stores UTF-8 (no ECI).

ec_level : {"L", "M", "Q", "H"}

誤り訂正レベル / error-correction level.

version : int or None

1..40。None なら収まる最小 / 1..40, or None for the smallest that fits.

mask : int or None

0..7。None なら 4 規則の減点が最小のもの / 0..7, or None to pick by penalty.

mode : {"numeric", "alphanumeric", "byte"} or None

None なら文字種から自動 / None to choose from the characters.

Returns

dict

modules (N,N) uint8 (1=暗/dark), size, version, ec_level, mask,

mode, text, blocks [(n_data, n_ec)…], n_data_codewords,

n_ec_codewords, function_mask (N,N) bool, codeword_index (N,N) int16

(-1 = 機能/余り / function or remainder), codewords (interleaved list).
